name: Version Story Compare
long_description: Redline in Claude with perfect precision. Version Story is the redlining infrastructure partner for your legal business in the age of AI. Claude searches, summarizes, and creates. Version Story validates. We handcrafted our redline engine in partnership with law firms, including Dentons and Addleshaw Goddard. It is an algorithm, which means the result is the same every time. This is the perfect complement to the generative properties of AI. Wherever you work - whether in Claude, in ChatGPT, or in our standalone app - Version Story provides review and verification you can trust. And for those building out custom tools, we support embedding our redlining in your stack.
